THE URBAN DEVELOPMENT PROJECTS (SPECIAL PROVISIONS) ACT, No. 2 OF 1980
Order under Section 2

BY virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 2 of the Urban Development Projects (Special Provisions) Act,No. 2 of 1980, I, Maithripala Sirisena, President of Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka upon the recommendationof the Minister-in-Charge of the subject of Megapolis and Western Development being of the opinion that the landsspecified in the shcedules hereto are urgently required for the purpose of developing the Horana Industrial Zone andUrban Development Project do by this order, declare that the said lands are required for such purpose.
MAITHRIPALA SIRISENA,President.Presidential Secretariat,Colombo 01,30th July, 2016.
SCHEDULE

Boundaries of Lot A and B depicted in sketch No. 0006/2016 dated 17.03.2016 prepared by Mrs. R. C.Liyanaarachchi, Land Officer (UDA) for the land in extent of 43 Hectares (106A., 00R., 34P.) situated in“Olaboduwawaththa”, “Nayagodawaththa” and “Minehenawaththa” in Koralaima and Olaboduwa North Grama NiladhariDivisions within Horana Divisional Secretary’s Division in Kalutara District, Western Province
Boundaries of the land are as follows :
North : Assetments Nos. 213/2, 213/4 lands owned by Saman Kumara and others in Koralaima Zoysa Mawatha,Olabodu Kanda Road, Nayagoda Road, Bare land and Paddy Lands.

East : Olabadu Kanda Road, Assetment Nos. 260/41/S3, 260/41/A lands owned by A. Wickramasinghe andothers in Rose Garden Road, Community Centre, abandoned paddy lands and bare lands, AssetmentNo. 211/1 and owner and Assetment No. undefined house and paddy lands.
